_about: NCLL's own vocabulary, written down once. Two uses: (1) Ask NCLL's search treats each 'sameAs' group as one word, so a family's words find the page's words; (2) the bot reads 'terms' with every question so it understands league words the way we mean them. Rules: only what words MEAN, never decisions (fees, dates, ages and coaches live in facts-2027.json with a source); every term cites where it's already said; if a family would need a term to understand a page, the page should say it too. Started 2026-11-06; John approved the first draft.

terms.means: The age that decides a player's division for the season: the player's age on August 31 of the season year (baseball) or December 31 of the year before the season (softball). It is often different from the player's age today.
terms.source: Registration page (registration-main.html, League Age; wording fixed r54, 2026-11-06); Softball Hub

terms.means: Going into that division this coming spring. In the winter, players are between divisions, so 'rising AAA' means a player who will play AAA in spring 2027.

terms.means: The level a player plays at, set by league age: baseball Tee Ball, Kindy, A, AA, AAA, Majors, Intermediate, Juniors, Seniors; softball A, AA, AAA, Majors, Juniors, Seniors. Ages per division are in the facts file.
NCLL's off-season programs, named for the season they lead into: Winterball27 runs in the winter of 2026-27, before the 2027 spring season.

Not tryouts: every player makes a team. Assessments help place players and build even teams for the draft (AAA and Majors).
